# D2D HealthCo

> > D2D HealthCo is a Canadian dental and medical supply distributor offering professional-grade instruments, consumables, PPE, and infection control products for healthcare providers.

D2D HealthCo specializes in both proprietary house brand products and trusted third-party brands like MARK3, Accel, and Kohler Medizintechnik. The company serves dental and medical professionals across Canada with FDA and Health Canada certified supplies, emphasizing quality German steel instruments, infection control solutions, and cost-effective consumables.

## Key Topics

- D2D House Brand
- Dental Instruments & Supplies
- Periodontal Curettes (Gracey Series)
- TRINOVO Handle Technology
- German Steel Instruments
- Level 1 PPE & Isolation Gowns
- Infection Control & Disinfection
- Accel INTERVention Wipes
- Dispensing Tips & Consumables
- High Volume Suction (HVE)
- Health Canada & FDA Certification
- AAMI Standards
- Kohler Medizintechnik
- MARK3 Products
- Subgingival Scaling Tools
